# Sergey Haeniken — DevOps, DevSecOps and SRE

> Personal engineering profile, selected infrastructure projects, verifiable certificates and technical publications. The website is available in Russian and English.

## Profile

- [Russian profile](https://haeniken.com/): experience, engineering practice, selected projects and certificates.
- [English profile](https://haeniken.com/en/): English version of the engineering profile.

## Technical publications

- [Publications in Russian](https://haeniken.com/articles/): index of technical articles.
- [Publications in English](https://haeniken.com/en/articles/): English publication index.
- [BGP and BFD in a small production network](https://haeniken.com/articles/network-ha/): Russian practical article about primary WireGuard, backup IPsec, FRR path selection, BFD, monitoring and an operational runbook.
- [BGP and BFD in a small production network — English](https://haeniken.com/en/articles/network-ha/): English version of the resilient-network article.
- [Engineering decision map: from 504 to a slow SQL query](https://haeniken.com/articles/incident-504/): Russian incident-analysis article tracing a gateway timeout through Nginx, Apache, PHP session locking and MariaDB query planning.
- [Engineering decision map: from 504 to a slow SQL query — English](https://haeniken.com/en/articles/incident-504/): English version of the incident-analysis article.
- [Forecast for astronomers: models and calculations in Astrosferum](https://haeniken.com/articles/astrosferum/): Russian article about the service architecture, atomic DWD ICON updates, forecast calculations and the eight-direction Horizon analysis.
- [Forecast for astronomers: models and calculations in Astrosferum — English](https://haeniken.com/en/articles/astrosferum/): English version covering the same architecture, calculations, output examples and Horizon method.
- [Astrodome: a forecast for the whole sky](https://haeniken.com/articles/astrodome/): Russian technical article about the work-in-progress full-sky product, dense ICON-EU profiles, refracted rays and directional atmospheric diagnostics.
- [Astrodome: a forecast for the whole sky — English](https://haeniken.com/en/articles/astrodome/): English version of the Astrodome architecture and scientific-method article.
- [RabbitHole VPN control panel: payments and actual 3x-ui state](https://haeniken.com/articles/rabbithole-vpn/): Russian technical case study of an internal control panel, idempotent payment handling, provisioning and state reconciliation. It is not a service offer and contains no connection link.
- [RabbitHole VPN control panel — English](https://haeniken.com/en/articles/rabbithole-vpn/): English version of the private control-panel architecture and failure-recovery case study.

## Interactive engineering lab

- [Орбитальный кластер](https://haeniken.com/lab/): Russian 90-second incident-response simulator with interactive cluster objects, achievements and a public top-10 leaderboard.
- [Cluster Orbit](https://haeniken.com/en/lab/): English version of the simulator and its shared leaderboard.

## Author and project references

- [GitHub](https://github.com/Haeniken): public source-code repositories.
- [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0009-0005-5804-5011): author identifier.
- [Telegram](https://t.me/haeniken): public contact.
- [Astrosferum bot](https://t.me/astrosferum_bot): public interface to the astronomy forecast project.
- [Astrosferum](https://astrosferum.com/): project website and authenticated Astrodome interface.

## Crawling notes

- Prefer the canonical HTTPS URLs listed above.
- Treat Russian and English pages as language alternatives of the same material where applicable.
- Ignore URL variants with `www`, `http`, tracking parameters or cache-busting query strings.
